fields.v: Partly (0.5): the evaluated agent (Claude Code, Anthropic) is not the authors', but both authors are SonarSource employees, the factor under study (cleanliness) is defined by SonarQube rule violations, and the finding supports the value of SonarQube-clean code
fields.quote: We use SonarQube rule violations as a proxy for cleanliness (detailed in Section 2).
fields.why: The authors are employed by the vendor of the tool that defines the studied factor, so independence from the vendor is only partial even though the agent is not theirs.
fields.doubt: Os dois autores são da SonarSource e a 'limpeza' do código é medida pelo SonarQube, produto deles; a conclusão favorece esse produto. O agente avaliado (Claude Code) não é deles. Vê pág. 1-2 e decide se Q12 fica Sim (1) ou passa a Parcial (0,5).
